summary: Repair alert history declarations, isolate foreign source failures and retain bounded page omissions.

schema.detail: No new replicated claim fields, SQL table or index in this correction; the earlier delegated diagnostic schema decision remains required.

rules.detail: No authority or writer rule changed; owner filtering in retained history happens before decoding and source availability checks.

compatibility.detail: Client PageInfo gains optional omitted_items in schema, templates and Rust/Swift/TypeScript models. History always supplies its count and advances past unreadable candidates; old page paths omit it. Older consumers can ignore it but cannot claim the new completeness guarantee; Rust struct literals require an optional field. Canonical codegen equality and behavior require hosted qualification.

downtime.detail: No deployment, live mutation or restart in this source correction.

manual.detail: Keep Draft until the existing Intake source review and curator-held replicated-schema/policy/client decisions. Client history consumers must follow sparse-page cursors within five minutes and retain an incomplete warning for nonzero omissions, including at end.

recovery.detail: Wide, malformed or source-incomplete history candidates cannot poison all later pages. Known foreign-owner failures do not affect a person's page. Missing authority or original native acceptance remains unqualified.
